name: Adventurer's Ring
text: A ring with a cover that, when open, produces a heatless, fuelless flame giving Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for 20 feet beyond. Opening or closing the cover is a Bonus Action.

name: Armor of Gleaming
text: Armor that stays spotless no matter what. It has no mechanical effect beyond that.

name: Bead of Refreshment
text: Drop this bead into a pint of liquid to turn it into fresh, cold drinking water. It does nothing to magical liquids or poisons.

name: Boots of False Tracks
text: Wearing these boots lets you make your footprints look like those of any Humanoid your size.

name: Candle of the Deep
text: A candle whose flame keeps burning when submerged in water. It gives off normal candlelight and heat.

name: Cast-Off Armor
text: Armor you can take off quickly, using a Magic action.

name: Charlatan's Die
text: A six-sided die you can make land on any number you choose each time you roll it.

name: Cloak of Billowing
text: With a Bonus Action you can make the cloak flutter dramatically for up to 1 minute, purely for show.

name: Cloak of Many Fashions
text: A Bonus Action lets you restyle the cloak's look, color, and apparent quality, though it stays a cloak with the same weight. It can copy the look of other magic cloaks without gaining their powers.

name: Clockwork Amulet
text: Once per dawn, when you make an attack roll while wearing it, you can count the d20 as a 10 instead of rolling.

name: Clothes of Mending
text: This outfit repairs its own everyday wear and tear, but pieces that are destroyed stay destroyed.

name: Conjurer's Canopy
text: A Magic action plants the walking stick and creates a 20-foot cube of clear force for 1 hour (or until you end it with a Magic action). The cube keeps out rain and snow and keeps the air dry, while creatures can still pass through; the stick then needs 1d12 hours before it can be used again.

name: Dark Shard Amulet
text: Works as a Warlock spellcasting focus. Once per Long Rest, you can try a Warlock action cantrip you don't know, succeeding on a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check; a failure wastes the action.

name: Dictation Quill
text: With a Magic action and a command word, this quill writes down your next spoken or signed words at 25 words per minute for up to 1 hour, until its paper, parchment, or ink runs out, or until you stop it with another command word.

name: Dread Helm
text: A fearsome steel helm that makes your eyes glow red and hides your face in shadow. It is cosmetic only.

name: Ear Horn of Hearing
text: Hold this horn to your ear to suppress the Deafened condition while you use it.

name: Elocutionist's Lexicon
text: With a Magic action you can think of a specific word, and the book opens to the exact page where that word is defined.

name: Enduring Spellbook
text: A spellbook, and everything written in it, that fire and water cannot damage. It also never deteriorates with age.

name: Ensorcelled Missive
text: Works as a sheet of parchment. After writing, use a Magic action to seal it with a word or short phrase; anyone who opens it without that phrase sees unintelligible script.

name: Ersatz Eye
text: A magical eye that replaces a lost one and lets you see through it normally. You can insert or remove it with a Magic action, but it cannot be taken out against your will while you live.

name: Eternal Chalk
text: Chalk that does not wear down with normal use. You choose the marks' color and whether they glow faintly, and no one but you can erase them for 7 days.

name: Evergreen Fertilizer
text: Sprinkle this powder on the soil around a nonmagical plant to keep it healthy for 365 days.

name: Hat of Vermin
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. A Magic action and 1 charge summon a Bat, Frog, or Rat that is not under your control and vanishes after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

name: Hat of Wizardry
text: Works as a Wizard spellcasting focus. Once per Long Rest you can try a Wizard action cantrip you don't know, succeeding on a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check; a failure wastes the action.

name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch
text: A belt pouch with 10 charges. A Magic action and 1 charge let you name a nonmagical seasoning and pull a pinch of it out, enough for one meal. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges at dawn.

name: Homeward Compass
text: Use a Magic action to point the compass's needle at your current location. It can only track one location at a time, and it spins aimlessly if it is on another plane or has no target.

name: Horn of Silent Alarm
text: Has 4 charges that regain 1d4 at dawn. Blowing it with a Magic action and 1 charge sounds an alarm that only one creature you choose can hear, if that creature is within 600 feet.

name: Instrument of Illusions
text: While playing it, a Magic action creates harmless, obviously fake visual effects in a 5-foot-radius area (15 feet for Bards). The effects end when you stop playing.

name: Instrument of Scribing
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. While playing, spend 1 charge to write a message of up to 6 words (Bards can add 7 more and make it glow) on a nonmagical surface within 30 feet. The writing fades after 24 hours unless Dispel Magic removes it sooner.

name: Lock of Trickery
text: An ordinary-looking lock with one key. Dexterity checks made to pick it have Disadvantage.

name: Lucky Foot
text: When you roll a 1 on an ability check or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new result. The rabbit foot then crumbles to dust.

name: Adamantine Weapon
text: A weapon or piece of ammunition made of adamantine. Any hit it scores against an object is a Critical Hit.

name: Alarm Pylon
text: A 5-foot stone post you activate with a Magic action, choosing one trigger: a spell of a chosen school being cast, a creature taking 5 or more damage, or an object taking 10 or more damage. When the trigger happens within 300 feet, it rings an alarm audible up to 300 feet away for 10 seconds.

name: Alchemy Jug
text: Name a liquid with a Magic action and the jug produces it, pouring up to 2 gallons per minute. Amounts range from 1 quart of oil to 12 gallons of salt water, and it can't switch to another liquid, or make more of one already at its maximum, until the next dawn.

name: Arcane Battery
text: Touch it to a magic item with a Magic action. If that item regains charges at dawn, it immediately regains 1d4 + 1 charges, and the battery is then used up.

name: Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom
text: A Magic action animates the broom so it acts right after you on each round, moving as you command while within 30 feet. A Bonus Action with a command word returns it to normal; if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points it is destroyed, but if it returns to normal before that it regains all its Hit Points.

name: Blossom Rod
text: Its rarity depends on its variant. Budding can cast Druidcraft and Plant Growth (Overgrowth only), Flowering can cast Insect Plague once per dawn, and Somniferous can release a 30-foot cloud of sleep-inducing pollen (DC 17 Constitution save, 1 hour of Unconscious on failure) once per dawn.

name: Boon Companion's Bands
text: Come as a matched pair. Once per dawn, when a creature wearing the other band is caught in your spell or feature's area and must save, it succeeds automatically. Destroying one band turns the other to dust.

name: Boots of the Winding Path
text: A Bonus Action teleports you up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, as long as you occupied that space earlier in the same turn.

name: Cap of Vanishing
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. A Magic action and 1 charge make you Invisible for 10 minutes; the effect ends early if you take the cap off or make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Cap of Water Breathing
text: While wearing it underwater, a Magic action creates an air bubble around your head so you can breathe normally until you take the cap off or leave the water.

name: Climber's Ammunition
text: When it hits a solid surface it sticks, and a magic rope trails out that holds up to 500 pounds for 1 hour or until you dismiss it. If it hits a creature instead, it breaks on impact and deals no damage.

name: Dispelling Ammunition
text: When it damages a target, it ends any ongoing spell of 3rd level or lower on that target. After it deals damage it stops being magical.

name: Driftglobe
text: A 1-pound glass sphere that, within 60 feet, sheds Light or Daylight on command (Daylight only once per dawn). A Magic action makes it float up to 5 feet off the ground, and it follows you if you move more than 60 feet away.

name: Enspelled Armor
text: Bound with one spell of 8th level or lower (Abjuration or Illusion). It has 6 charges that regain 1d6 at dawn, and you spend 1 charge to cast the spell. The spell level sets the save DC (13 to 18), the attack bonus (+5 to +10), and the rarity.

name: Enspelled Staff
text: Bound with one spell of 8th level or lower, usable by spending 1 of its 6 charges (regained 1d6 at dawn). If you spend its last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 the staff becomes a plain Quarterstaff. The spell level sets the save DC, attack bonus, and rarity.

name: Enspelled Weapon
text: Bound with one spell of 8th level or lower (Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy, or Transmutation). It has 6 charges that regain 1d6 at dawn, and you spend 1 charge to cast the spell. The spell level sets the save DC (13 to 18), the attack bonus (+5 to +10), and the rarity.

name: Eyes of Deceit
text: Tinted crystal lenses that give you a +5 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks while worn.

name: Goading Ammunition
text: If it hits and deals damage, the target must make a DC 13 Charisma save or be unable to take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Then it stops being magical.

name: Hag Eye
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. Spend 1 to cast Darkvision on yourself or See Invisibility. A hag of the coven that made it can see through it, on the same plane, while concentrating.

name: Harkon's Bite
text: A necklace giving a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws. It is cursed: attuning binds you as a werewolf serving Harkon Lukas on nights of a full moon, and only his death lifts the curse.

name: Harper Pin
text: When you attune, pick a Harper persona that magic reads as your creature type, alignment, and location. Silver (Uncommon) lets you preload a thought of 25 words or fewer; Golden (Rare) lets you cast Nondetection on yourself permanently until you turn it off.

name: Hat of Vortexes
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. A Magic action and 1 charge release a vortex filling a 10-foot cube from you for 1 hour, and that area counts as Difficult Terrain.

name: Helm of Awareness
text: Gives you Advantage on Initiative rolls while worn.

name: Idol of Good Fortunes
text: Its form sets the rarity: Blemished casts Augury once per dawn, Tarnished gives +1 to AC while attuned and can turn a nonmagical trade bar or gem into coins by touch, and Golden casts Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn.

name: Instrument of the Bards
text: Each of seven bard-college instruments casts Fly, Invisibility, Levitate, and Protection from Evil and Good, plus its own specific spells, once per dawn per spell. Playing it without attunement forces a DC 15 Wisdom save or 2d4 Psychic damage.

name: Keoghtom's Ointment
text: A jar with 1d4 + 1 doses. Use a Utilize action to swallow a dose or apply it to a creature within 5 feet, restoring 2d8 + 2 Hit Points and ending the Poisoned condition.

name: Keyholes Dagger
text: A Dagger that grants +1, +2, or +3 to attack and damage rolls depending on its variant (Three, Ten, or Many keyholes). Taking the Attack action lets you transform it into a Handaxe or Mace, and higher variants add more forms and one reroll per dawn for a missed attack.

name: Amulet of Retributive Healing
text: Has 3 charges that regain 1d4 at dawn. When you restore Hit Points to another creature, spend 1 charge to regain the same amount yourself.

name: Arcane Chantelaine
text: Has six spectral keys. A Magic action touches one key to a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch to cast Arcane Lock; each key vanishes after use, and the clasp disappears when all six are gone.

name: Arcanist's Bestiary
text: Attuned, you gain proficiency in one of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion, and can change the choice after each Long Rest. You can cast Charm Monster (DC 15) once per dawn while holding it, and it reveals creature resistances and immunities when you study certain monster types.

name: Bellows of Strangulation
text: Has 6 charges. Command words cost 1 charge to make one creature within 60 feet Incapacitated (DC 15 Constitution save), 3 charges to affect a 30-foot cone with the same effect, or 5 charges to cast Cloudkill (spell DC 17). It regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn, and using the last charge has a 1-in-20 chance to destroy it.

name: Blood Amulet
text: Has 3 charges that regain 1d3 at dawn. When you deal damage, spend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage and force a DC 15 Constitution save; on a failure the target gains 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Brooch of the Elements
text: Has 3 charges that all return at dawn. As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet hits with an attack that deals damage, spend 1 charge to change that damage to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

name: Cube of Summoning
text: Winding its crank with a Magic action summons a creature, with a d6 roll deciding the spell (Summon Aberration, Beast, Construct, Dragon, Elemental, or Fey). The summon is cast at 5th level with DC 17 and +9 to attack, and the cube can't summon again until the next dawn.

name: Dazzling Weapon
text: Grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. A Bonus Action sheds 30-foot Bright Light plus 30 feet of Dim Light. It has 4 charges that regain 1d4 at dawn; a Reaction spends one after a hit against you to force a DC 15 Constitution save, blinding the attacker until the end of its next turn on failure.

name: Dissuader
text: Acts as a +1 Quarterstaff. Once per dawn for each property, it can cast Calm Emotions (DC 15), create a 30-foot aura for 1 minute that frightens creatures who fail a DC 15 Wisdom save, or release a Reaction shockwave that pushes creatures within 30 feet back up to 30 feet on a failed DC 15 Strength save.

name: Dream Weaver
text: Hang it within 30 feet of you. During a Long Rest you can study it for an hour, storing a d20 roll you can swap in for one of your own D20 Tests before you finish the rest. It also records the caster of a Dream spell aimed at you and gives Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves while you're Unconscious.

name: Fork of Eddy Summoning
text: A Magic action taps the fork on an object to summon a friendly Eldritch Eddy in an unoccupied space near you. It lasts up to 1 hour, until it dies, or until you dismiss it as a Bonus Action, and the fork works only once per dawn.

name: Goggles of Foe-Finding
text: While worn, your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

name: Life-Sapping Blade
text: Grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. A hit deals an extra 2d4 Necrotic damage and stops the target from regaining Hit Points until the end of its next turn. A creature killed by this blade can only be brought back by Resurrection or True Resurrection.

name: Cauldron of Rebirth
text: Works as a Spellcasting Focus and can serve as a component for Scrying. After a Long Rest it can brew a greater Potion of Healing in 1 minute, lasting 24 hours. A Magic action can grow it to hold a Medium creature; a Humanoid corpse covered with 200 pounds of salt (10 GP) for 8 hours returns to life at the next dawn, with a 7-day recharge.

name: Executioner's Axe
text: Grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. Each Humanoid you hit takes an extra 2d6 Slashing damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to that extra damage.

name: Lute of Thunderous Thumping
text: Can be wielded as a Club that deals an extra 2d8 Thunder damage on a hit. A Bard may use Charisma instead of Strength for melee attacks with it while singing or humming.

name: Apparatus of Kwalish
text: Looks like a 500-pound iron barrel but unfolds into a Large lobster-shaped vehicle with AC 20, 200 Hit Points, and a 30-foot Swim speed. It is steered from inside by one pilot working ten levers, and it can dive to 900 feet.

name: Crystal Ball of Ominous Portent
text: While touching it you can cast Hex or Scrying (DC 17). Once per dawn, when a creature you can see within 60 feet succeeds on a D20 Test, you can use a Reaction to force that roll to be a 1.

name: Deck of Many Things
text: You declare how many cards to draw from a 13- or 22-card deck, and each card's random magic takes effect when drawn, with the next draw within 1 hour. The effects are powerful and often risky, and most drawn cards go back into the deck, so the same card can come up again.

name: Diamond Staff
attunement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
text: A 20-charge staff that works as a +3 Quarterstaff. Charges pay for spells (Detect Magic and Light are free, Identify costs 1, Knock and Maze cost more), a Dazzling Light (40-foot Bright Light radius), and a Stunning Hit (spend 2, DC 17 Constitution save). It regains 1d6 + 4 charges at dawn and is destroyed on a 1 when its last charge is spent.

name: Efreeti Chain
text: Chain Mail or Chain Shirt that grants +3 to AC, Immunity to Fire, the Primordial language, and the ability to stand on and move across molten rock.

name: Grave Reaper
text: Grants +2 to attack and damage rolls. A hit deals an extra 2d8 Necrotic damage, and once per dawn you can cast Spirit Lantern from it at DC 17 to hold up to five soul fragments.

name: Axe of the Dwarvish Lords
text: A Battleaxe that grants +3 to attack and damage rolls. A natural 20 on an attack roll deals an extra 20 Slashing damage, and thrown ranged hits add 1d8 Force damage (2d8 against Giants).

name: Blackrazor
text: A +3 Greatsword that deals 1d10 extra Necrotic to Undead and devours the soul of any non-Undead, non-Construct creature it reduces to 0 Hit Points. Holding it gives Immunity to Charmed and Frightened and 30 feet of Blindsight, and a soul-devouring creature can only be revived by Wish.

name: Book of Exalted Deeds
text: An Artifact tome that takes 80 hours of study to gain its benefits, including Immunity to Charmed and Frightened and more while you keep doing good. Fiends, Undead, and Lower Planes servants that try to read it take 24d6 Radiant damage.

name: Book of Vile Darkness
text: An Artifact tome that takes 80 hours of study to gain its benefits. A creature that isn't a Fiend or Undead must make a DC 17 Charisma save when attuning or be turned into a Larva, and the benefits end if you go 10 days without an evil act, and a good act ends them immediately.

name: Calimemnon Crystal
text: An Artifact diamond that works as an Arcane Focus while attuned, grants a 30-foot Fly speed with hovering, and lets you cast a few spells (DC 18) from it.

name: Crown Of Horns
text: An Artifact circlet that curses its attuned wearer: they become Neutral Evil and slowly transform into a Lich over 365 days. Only a Wish spell or Myrkul's will can break the curse.

name: Demonomicon of Iggwilv
text: An Artifact tome that gives Advantage on Intelligence checks about demons and Wisdom (Survival) checks about the Abyss. Once per dawn, with a Magic action, you can target a Fiend inside a Magic Circle and try to trap it in the book's pages with a DC 20 Charisma save made at Disadvantage.

name: Ebonbane
text: A sapient Chaotic Evil +3 Longsword Artifact. Hitting a Celestial or Humanoid adds 3d6 Necrotic damage, and holding it gives Advantage on saves against spells. If it goes 3 days without slaying one, the wielder risks domination on a DC 17 Charisma save at dawn, and leaving the Shadowlands ends attunement and sends it back to its manor.

name: Eye and Hand of Vecna
text: Two separate Artifacts (the Eye and the Hand) that each grant random properties and make the wearer Neutral Evil. The Eye gives 240-foot Truesight and spells from 8 charges (DC 18), while the Hand sets Strength to 20 and adds Icy Touch.
